topic.title: Local Nature Recovery Strategies / Responsible Authorities / Delivery
topic.source_contract: strategy area and responsible authority, statutory preparation procedure, evidence base, priorities, opportunity mapping, consultation, publication, planning regard, funded actions, delivery and outcome monitoring evidence

scope_guards: An LNRS opportunity map is not an exact parcel designation.
A biodiversity priority is not planning permission or a funded project.
Responsible-authority appointment is not a published strategy.
A draft strategy is not an adopted or published strategy.
Publication is not evidence that mapped actions are funded.
A funded action is not completed habitat creation.
Habitat creation is not treated as measured ecological outcome.
No score or promotion is written without exact strategy, action, delivery and monitoring evidence.
